open_points.subject: record_change ordering of RecordRunProgressChange executions
open_points.text: The records one change writes take their store positions with every StoredValue first, in the order the variant names them, then the other records in the order the field-assignment note of its variant lists them, the elements of a list of records in list order (a RecordRunProgressChange's executions in (node_id, map_index) order); an update keeps the record's position, so positions never depend on record type or database insertion order.
open_points.other_text: attempt_number of a NodeExecution written by RecordRunProgressChange, RecordReadOutcomeChange, RecordOperationFailureChange or DecideApprovalChange, and of an EffectAttempt written by RecordAttemptInFlightChange, is one more than the number of NodeExecutions the element already has, the length of list_node_execution_rows_by_element for its ElementKey, and RequestApprovalChange gives the EffectApproval it writes that same next number as its attempt_number without writing a NodeExecution; RecordRunProgressChange writes its executions in (node_id, map_index) order with an absent map_index before index 0. A NodeExecution whose files were spooled before it is written carries the attempt_number its caller spooled them under, the element's next number read as the count of its NodeExecutions plus one; the change is refused with RefusedError, writing nothing, when that number is no longer the element's next, and no caller ever chooses another number.
open_points.question: Must RecordRunProgressChange executions retain the submitted list order, or must they be reordered by (node_id, map_index)?

open_points.subject: record_change return value for an existing StoredValue
open_points.text: A StoredValue whose value_id already exists is not written again and the existing record is returned in its place, since equal values share one identity; spooled files must already be published in the run's spool by spool_file before the change that writes their SpooledFile records.
open_points.other_text: Returns a RecordSet holding every record the change wrote or changed, each with every identity, attempt_number and by-field the module assigned; a store position is no field of a record (decision 23) except where it is the record's identity — the store_position field of an Activation or a FlowActivation, which the module assigns and returns.
open_points.question: Must an existing unchanged StoredValue be returned, or must the RecordSet contain only records actually written or changed?
